insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A new `trackingNumbers` field has been added to `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput`. This allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders. The change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the `orderCreate` mutation should update their code to utilize the new `trackingNumbers` field. This will enable them to provide more accurate and detailed tracking information for fulfillments. No migration is required, but developers should test their implementations to ensure compatibility. The `orderCreate` mutation is commonly used in Shopify Functions and other custom integrations, so developers should review their code to take advantage of this new feature.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving the overall customer experience. This change will also help merchants to better manage their fulfillments and shipments.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking shipments, which is essential for merchants to manage their orders and fulfillments efficiently. It also enhances the customer experience by providing more detailed tracking information.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen is now available on development stores, and the Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings. Additionally, @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen have been patched with improvements to local debugger connections.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. The Customer object in Shopify Functions also now includes a `createdAt` field.

themes.title: Upcoming Changes and Requirements
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and updating an order's shipping address will recalculate taxes as of August 31, 2026. Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have also been updated.
